counterfactual_missing_items: nonspecific chronic fibrosing inflammation without evidence of neoplasia, granulomas, or fungi
ANCA serology and renal/pulmonary involvement not supplied
decisive_items: bone discontinuity of the maxillary, septal, sphenoid, ethmoidal walls, and pterygopalatine fossa
a discrete medial bulging of the left nasal fossa lateral wall and a leftward septal deviation
response.rationale: R5 best fits the sinonasal-orbito-destructive syndrome with chronic fibrosing inflammation and marked ESR/CRP; granulomas can be absent on a small mucosal biopsy. R8 has important anatomy but is directly undermined by absence of fungi and negative Cryptococcus antigen. R1/R2/R4 have no confirmatory neoplastic cells, and R3 lacks site-specific/histologic support.

rejected.why: Frozen 'probable low-grade lymphoproliferative lesion' is contradicted by paraffin 'without evidence of neoplasia' and negative CSF cytology.
Only prior cervical adenocarcinoma; no adenocarcinoma cells in biopsy or CSF and final biopsy excludes neoplasia.
Imaging mass is nonspecific and final biopsy excludes neoplasia; no olfactory/neuroepithelial features.
Radiologic destructive maxillary sinus mass is nonspecific; no squamous carcinoma cells and final biopsy excludes neoplasia.
